set.body:
Current release queue, 7 October 2026: release-later; milestone-interview.
Plan: docs/refactor/RELEASE-QUEUE.md. Mote remains authoritative; one primary agent and at most one helper.

Reconciliation: Acceptance retained; this audit did not run its proposed tests.

Remaining / next action: After membership routing and conditional gating, implement per-metric exclusion while retaining the account-level summary. Show exactly which six quantities move, with before/after fixtures and contributor/denominator evidence.

Release tags schedule work; they do not establish completion or empirical qualification. Use current AGENTS.md for ownership, scoped gates and exact-SHA review; old fleet roles, timers and fixed gate task counts are historical. Keep the original scientific preregistration, denominators, admission and sealed-test rules below.

Retained acceptance and design context:

Scheduling lane: later. Current plan: docs/refactor/PLAN.md. Live dependency edges supersede historical sequencing below.

Current disposition, 2026-09-19; governing docs/refactor/PLAN.md.
Interview-specific scientific work remains valid but follows the mapping preview; reuse measurement policy when this work resumes.

Original scope retained below for evidence; fleet procedure/assignments are historical and do not govern single-developer work.

KNOWN INCOMPLETENESS, opened deliberately rather than discovered later.

Chief ruled reading (B) on 2026-08-30 for the membership-routing work: mass goes to PlacementResolution's `excluded` arm iff it reaches NO metric's predicate at MembershipThreshold (Scoring.scala:384, 0.5).

(B) is a strict improvement -- it can never exclude mass a metric could have used -- but m1 correctly identified that (C), PER-METRIC exclusion, is the more truthful reading. Under (B), eventPurity still conditions on units that are members of, say, Repetition but not of the event class. That residue is real and unmeasured.

WHY NOT NOW: (C) changes PlacementResolution from ONE SUMMARY PER ACCOUNT to one per metric. That is a different shape, not a larger version of the same one, and it deserves its own before/after on the figures rather than arriving inside a carrier ruling.

MIGRATION: under (C) the meaning of the (B) field changes. README already states APIs change without notice, so this is acceptable -- but acceptable because it is recorded here, not because nobody will notice.

Membership predicates in source: Scoring.scala:413 (targetMass under a phase predicate), :501 (massAt(pred), arbitrary), :564 (targetMass). Raised by claude-storymodel4s-m1, who declined to pick a reading silently.
